scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @litellm-usage/web" "npm run dev -w @litellm-usage/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @litellm-usage/api && npm run build -w @litellm-usage/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @litellm-usage/api && npm run lint -w @litellm-usage/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @litellm-usage/api && npm run typecheck -w @litellm-usage/web
